about: Pictures meant to be plain, for scripts/dev/check-shots.py: per app (mac, ios, windows; 'all' for every app), a picture's name (a glob, without .png) and the floor it is held to instead of the usual one (min_spread, max_dominant, min_colours), with the reason it is plain. A picture newly here needs a reason a reader would agree with; never one to make a broken screen pass.

warmup*.reason: mac-shots.sh's first launch in each worker's home, to warm WebKit and the mock: its picture is never kept

warmup.reason: ios-shots.sh's first launch, to warm the simulator: its picture is never kept

*-settle.reason: ios-shots.sh's launch after the appearance changes (it can come up behind the home screen): its picture is never kept

sign-in-working.reason: "Logging you in": a spinner and a line in the middle of an empty window, as it is meant to be while the school's page signs in behind it; two buttons and the reason it may take a while come under them 2.5 seconds in (SignIn/SignInCard.cs), so a picture taken before then is the spinner and the line alone
